# ReproDeck

Canonical description: Evidence-first debugging workbench for AI-assisted code fixes.

ReproDeck is a local-first Tauri desktop developer tool. It captures real failures, builds inspectable evidence, supports optional structured AI hypotheses, runs causal experiments in isolated Git worktrees, and backend-gates Apply on Before/After proof and required regressions for the exact patch.

## Safety boundary

Git worktrees isolate repository writes but are not an operating-system sandbox. Project code runs with the user's permissions. AI output is a proposal; ReproDeck's evidence and exact-patch verification layers remain authoritative.
